thesis: CROX is a high-quality, cash-generative post-earnings re-rating (net income up three straight quarters, forward P/E 9.99, rs_63 +0.43) basing in the 149-164 range above SMA20 157.16, which fits the provisional lesson favouring re-rated names that consolidate near highs. The bear wins on execution: the pre-market quote of 161.44 sits above the 156.5-159.5 zone, and at that price reward/risk to 172.8 with the 153.4 stop is only 1.41, below the 1.5 floor (lesson 3). Add to that a risk-off regime at 0.9 confidence, a beta-1.5 name, fading volume into the 164.24 high and a thin half-day session. Hold for now; upgrade to Overweight at pre-close only if price trades back into the zone (3.2 R/R from a 158 mid) while it holds above 153.4.
invalidation: A daily close below 153.4 ends the higher-low sequence, and a close below 149.0 (Oct 30 low) breaks the post-gap base.
